confirmed_differences: Native DATA retry final expiry removes HOP owner but preserves separately queued MAC copies; MATLAB failEntry unconditionally cancels those copies.
Native exact ACK and cumulative ACK/DACK cancel matching queued copies even with no HOP owner; MATLAB cancellation requires complete() to return a live-owner pair.
scope: Existing source contract and observed queued-DATA cases. Does not establish full-network parity or causal fraction of aggregate latency.
